results.title: EPA — Desalination Energy Overview (recorded)
results.content: Desalination requires substantial energy input. Reverse osmosis typically consumes 3-6 kWh per cubic meter. Brine discharge can raise local salinity.

results.title: UNESCO-IOC — Marine impacts of brine (recorded)
results.content: Brine plumes increase salinity and temperature in mixing zones. Intake impingement affects plankton. Effects decline with distance.
